name: Contributor Actions

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - '.github/workflows/**'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      lint-success: ${{ steps.lint.outcome }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - id: lint
        run: npm run lint
        continue-on-error: false

  typecheck:
    name: Type Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    outputs:
      typecheck-success: ${{ steps.typecheck.outcome }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - id: typecheck
        run: npm run type-check
        continue-on-error: false

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck]
    outputs:
      test-success: ${{ steps.test.outcome }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - id: test
        run: npm test
        continue-on-error: false
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: ./coverage

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: ${{ needs.test.result == 'success' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: ./dist

  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://example.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run deploy

  staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' && github.event_name == 'push'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.example.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run deploy:staging
